thread:
Alyssa: Quick sync — confirmed webinar date Thu 2026-04-14: "Benchmarking inference: cost vs latency". Need final checklist for reg page, Zoom preflight, recording/retention, and post-event follow-up.
Mike: Key asks for reg page: timezone auto-detect + manual selector, 1-click calendar add, pre-fill job title & company for lead routing. Also dataLayer must capture utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_medium, landing_variant.
Jordan: Lead routing plan: HubSpot -> list 'webinar-benchmark-2026' and tag contacts with source from UTM (e.g., source:webinar_paid). Add a boolean property 'opted_followup' from the checkbox.
Helen: Zoom config: cloud record, separate audio/video, enable auto-captions, panelist recording allowed. Set host & co-hosts. Retain raw cloud files 90 days then move to S3 lifecycle to STANDARD_IA.
Alyssa: SRTs required for clip creation and accessibility. Retain transcripts & recordings 90 days in S3 then archive. Also add clip generation SLA: 2 business days for candidate clips; final 3 clips delivered in 3 business days.
Mike: Ownership: Content owns clip timestamps. Suggest auto-candidate generation using transcript keyword search (latency, quantization, batching) to speed selection.
Jordan: I'll build a small Lambda to index transcripts and return top 8 candidate clips with confidence scores. Ops picks final 3. Also scoring rules: >50% attendance => tag lead:high; clip CTR => engagement:clip; clicked replay => watched:yes.
Helen: Recording ingestion flow (ops): Zoom cloud -> zoom-automator webhook -> Lambda processor -> push recording & raw transcript to s3://redwood-recordings/webinar-benchmark/{meeting_ts}/. Then trigger Otter.ai for refined SRT. Small events (<500 regs) will use Zapier path: webhook -> Zap -> HubSpot create/update contact -> add to list.
Mike: Dev note: ensure replay links append UTMs per clip i.e. ?utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=benchmark_apr26&utm_content=clip1 so ad attribution works.
Alyssa: Reg page copy: highlight live benchmarks, interactive Q&A, and a gated benchmark report download. Include opt-in checkbox for a follow-up demo. CTA: "Reserve my spot + get the benchmark report".
Jordan: HubSpot mapping example for devs:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "hs_lists": ["webinar-benchmark-2026"],
  "properties": {"landing_variant": "A", "opted_followup": "false"}
}
```
Helen: Zoom preflight scheduled Tue 2026-04-12. Items: captions test, cloud recording test, co-host roles, bandwidth check, and backup recovery room. Inviting Mike, Jordan, Alyssa.
Mike: I'll create a secondary Zoom recovery meeting and include that link in the host playbook. Also will validate max participant caps and live streaming limits.
Alyssa: Post-event emails: 1) Thank you + full recording + survey + CTA to download benchmark report; 2) 48hr highlight email with 3 short clips (30s, 60s, 2min) + SRTs + demo opt-in. Include short survey to capture Dedicated vs Private interest.
Jordan: Lead tag flow: when transcript request/played -> HubSpot property watched:yes. When clip clicked -> add property engagement:clip. High engagement triggers notification to AE queue.
Helen: Ops snippet to move recordings after 90 days:
```
# aws cli
aws s3 mv s3://zoom-temp/meeting-12345/2026-04-14 s3://redwood-recordings/webinar-benchmark/2026-04-14 --storage-class STANDARD_IA
```
Ops-bot: Recording uploaded to s3://redwood-recordings/webinar-benchmark/1712345678 by zoom-automator. Transcription job id: 9a7b started and Otter.ai webhook registered.
Mike: For clip generation, we'll auto-search transcript for keywords then output candidate timestamps. Ops selects final three and we render via ffmpeg. Include captions burned-in for social clips.
Alyssa: Owners recap: Content (clips & copy) — Mike; Ops (ingest/transcript/transfers) — Helen; Growth (routing & scoring) — Jordan; Marketing (landing + emails) — Alyssa.
Jordan: I'll prepare a validation dataset to test tagging + UTM attribution by Mon 2026-04-11.
Mike: I'll draft the post-event email templates and upload to the marketing repo.
Alyssa: Perfect. I'll collate this into a checklist and share the reg page + initial email drafts by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
